name: Maya Reyes
title: Embedded Systems Engineer
bio: Maya builds low-power sensor devices and loves teaching beginners how to read their first analog value. She started with a blinking LED in college and never stopped.

name: Jon Dizon
title: IoT Developer
bio: Jon connects microcontrollers to dashboards for farms and small factories. He'll show how to send sensor data online with Wi-Fi boards.

name: Rica Tan
title: Robotics Instructor
bio: Rica coaches high school robotics teams and designs hands-on lessons that make physics click.

name: Paolo Garcia
title: Hardware Designer
bio: Paolo designs custom boards and will walk through moving a project off the breadboard and onto a real PCB.

name: Lea Domingo
title: Maker & Artist
bio: Lea mixes code, light and fabric into interactive installations. Her talk is about creative coding with addressable LEDs.
